name: stateroot
description: Cross-harness continuity for AI coding agents: shared persona, memory, plans, skills, sessions, and provable project-state lineage across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code, Pi, and DeepSeek Harness. MCP stdio bridge plus bootstrap skill; lifecycle capture still requires `stateroot install` hooks.

notes.hooks: Run `stateroot install` for harness-native lifecycle hooks. Agent Plugins transport does not replace automatic capture or cross-harness projection.
notes.session_skill: Embedded session protocol ships inside the CLI at stateroot-cli/assets/stateroot-skill/ and is installed per harness by `stateroot init` / `stateroot install`.
